propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Praesta, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, qui sanctorum tuorum Alexandri,
Eventii, Theoduli atque Juvenalis natalicia colimus; a cunctis malis
imminentibus, eorum intercessionibus, liberemur. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Super has hostias, quaesumus, Domine, benedictio copiosa descendat: quae et
sanctificationem nobis clementer operetur, et de Sanctorum nos solemnitate
laetificet. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A pre-1955 lay hand missal, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its rubrics, its seasonal second and third orations, its Holy Week and its sanctoral are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

The 3 May Mass of the Finding of the Holy Cross begins on leaf n585, printed p. 577, where this file already records the commemoration's Collect. Its second Secret, `SECRET. Of SS. ALEXANDER, &c.`, stands on leaf n587, printed p. 579, and is set with no Latin cue; it answers `Super has hostias, quaesumus Domine`. Page-image collation confirms that this historical English body answers the complete target Latin identity; publication is limited to the 1861 wording and does not claim that Cummiskey appoints the 1962 celebration.

translations.text: Let thy heavenly blessing, we beseech thee, O Lord, plentifully descend upon these oblations, which, through thy bounty, sanctify us and fill us with joy in the solemnity of thy saints. Thro'.
